description:
This is a sources sought notice issued for market research purposes only.  Defense Logistics Agency-Energy (DLA-E), on behalf of Warner Robins-Air Logistics Complex (WR-ALC) on Robins Air Force Base, Georgia is seeking information from qualified and eligible Utility providers regarding their company's capability, resources, and experience to perform a Utility Energy Service Contract (UESC) project at WR-ALC. 

Attachment (1) contains description of the UESC requirements and instructions on how to submit responses.
